title: Agent Teleshko wants info

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Please provide your reports on the suspects.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please provide your reports on the suspects.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: First, let us discuss Dotson. The robotic detective is pulling at threads best left undisturbed. His agency is about to unravel. Several of his investigations must be put to an end.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: First, let us discuss Dotson. The robotic detective is pulling at threads best left undisturbed. His agency is about to unravel. Several of his investigations must be put to an end.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: That is not an information you need to know. But his agency threatens to stir a sleeping giant in the crime world of Nivalis. One even CorpSec does not confront. Also... he does not have a permit for the parking outside his office.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That is not an information you need to know. But his agency threatens to stir a sleeping giant in the crime world of Nivalis. One even CorpSec does not confront. Also... he does not have a permit for the parking outside his office.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Your friend is far too chummy with his business rivals. Rivalry should not be friendly. It should be fierce. Competitive. It should seek the destruction of all enemies. So what did you find out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your friend is far too chummy with his business rivals. Rivalry should not be friendly. It should be fierce. Competitive. It should seek the destruction of all enemies. So what did you find out?

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Well, that's not a great result, informant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, that's not a great result, informant.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I applaud the spirit if not the sentiment. You continue to meet my expectations.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I applaud the spirit if not the sentiment. You continue to meet my expectations.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Yes indeed, the amateur vandal. It would be easy enough to catch them in the act. They could be re-educated right now if we wanted to take them in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes indeed, the amateur vandal. It would be easy enough to catch them in the act. They could be re-educated right now if we wanted to take them in.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I am playing the long game with that one. We hope they might lead us to bigger fish.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am playing the long game with that one. We hope they might lead us to bigger fish.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Clever bunny. You're smarter than you look.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Clever bunny. You're smarter than you look.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I haven't made up my mind about Zaffer, so just continue to keep your eye on them. Now run along bunny.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I haven't made up my mind about Zaffer, so just continue to keep your eye on them. Now run along bunny.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Well, I knew that! Though it is good to get confirmation. Good enough I suppose for a beginner informant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I knew that! Though it is good to get confirmation. Good enough I suppose for a beginner informant.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Well, THAT'S disappointing. I expected more from you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, THAT'S disappointing. I expected more from you.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Very well. Dotson is not the most important target, but I hope you have a better response for the others.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very well. Dotson is not the most important target, but I hope you have a better response for the others.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Business must show no mercy. He IS helping other businesses.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Business must show no mercy. He IS helping other businesses.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Business must show no mercy. He IS helping other businesses.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Business must show no mercy. He IS helping other businesses.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds a bit aggressive. I'm not sure if he is doing anything wrong.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds a bit aggressive. I'm not sure if he is doing anything wrong.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That sounds a bit aggressive. I'm not sure if he is doing anything wrong.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That sounds a bit aggressive. I'm not sure if he is doing anything wrong.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I could seek your destruction. And I'm not telling you anything about Danny.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could seek your destruction. And I'm not telling you anything about Danny.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I could seek your destruction. And I'm not telling you anything about Danny.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I could seek your destruction. And I'm not telling you anything about Danny.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll see what I can do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll see what I can do.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll see what I can do.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll see what I can do.
